anchors: Requirement: A winner reads their own payment and shipment state
Requirement: Every visible lot has one external lot status
Requirement: Auction order status is independent of store order status
Requirement: Order status is derived, never written
Requirement: Winner Order shows five progress steps

changes.reason: Only the Storybook path changed to match its new navigation group. The five-step progress design and the Preparing Shipment and Shipped presentations are unchanged.
The refreshed route suite retains the delivered My Auctions behavior: a paid undispatched row reads Preparing Shipment, and both Preparing Shipment and Shipped use the default badge.
evidence: Current account-record cases g10.auction-account-record.US3-TC20 and US3-TC23 assert those status and badge outcomes; the store test-case validator passes.

changes.reason: The suite was refreshed and its route format changed. Its relevant outcome remains that a lot with an order in Preparing Shipment has external lot status Ended, with the order status shown separately.
evidence: Current case g10.auction-lot-status.US1-TC1 states Preparing Shipment maps to Ended; the store test-case validator passes.

changes.reason: An accepted sibling change adds called-off-lot address release and browse removal to the feature set. The external status mapping still states Preparing Shipment maps to Ended, so these additions do not alter this change’s lot-status behavior.
evidence: Accepted release-called-off-listing-slugs commit 0b5b88783; current g10.auction-lot-status.US1-TC1 still verifies the Preparing Shipment to Ended mapping.

anchors: Requirement: Every visible lot has one external lot status
changes.reason: The requirement changes only the cross-reference to the renamed hidden-lot requirement. Its three external status values, derivation, and Preparing Shipment mapping do not change.

evidence: Accepted release-called-off-listing-slugs commit 0b5b88783; current g10.auction-lot-status.US1-TC1 continues to verify the unaffected status mapping.

evidence: Current cases g10.auction-order-status.US8-TC7 and US1-TC16 expect Preparing Shipment; the store test-case validator passes.

evidence: Current case g10.auction-order-status.US8-TC7 still verifies the paid-and-undispatched mapping; the store test-case validator passes.

evidence: Current cases g10.auction-winner-order.US2-TC55 and US2-TC20 assert those outcomes; the store test-case validator passes.
